posts.text: My statement on Georgia Senate Republicans' sham hearing:
Thank you for having me on, @KUOW. piped.video/watch?v=El4y_JFL…
Through intentional decisions that have chipped away at democracy’s guardrails, we are returning to the before-times when voters of color were silenced before a single vote was cast.
Today’s cruel ruling on Louisiana v. Callais guts what was left of the Voting Rights Act and sets us farther on the path to authoritarianism — aided and abetted by the Supreme Court.

The Voting Rights Act ended 150 years of Jim Crow and finally gave truth to the 15th Amendment. In a democracy, the faith of the people is born of a belief that they can participate in its processes and benefit from its success.
Tune into this week's episode of Assembly Required with our guest @yassaminansari! piped.video/EgZreUPPVg8?si=E38q…

Congressman David Scott was a dedicated public servant who believed in giving the last measure of his effort in pursuit of better. From our farmers to our small businesses, in the Georgia Assembly and the halls of Congress, he spoke up for millions. God’s peace to his family as he takes his final rest.

.@MiracleRankinGA and @JenJordanGA know that now is the time to fight for justice in our courts — and they have already proven they’re on the right side. Join them: justice4georgia.com



Jen Jordan (@JenJordanGA)

We'll fight for you on the Georgia Supreme Court.

#jen4georgia
#jen4justice
#georgiasupremecourt
